column1: Dataset S2: The 10,485 significant SNPs lying within genes or no more than 5kb away from them. Locations on chromosomes/scaffolds, where known, are shown, together with the identities of the gene and the impact of the SNP. As per Dataset S1, the identities of the nucleotide in the reference genome and the overall major and minor nucleotides are also shown, as well as the magnitude and direction of the frequency difference in each generation and the generation in which the difference was significant. Positive values indicate higher frequencies of the major nucleotides in the High resistance pool.
